note: Source specs for evals/b2e/*.b2e. Rebuild with: python evals/build_cases.py --all. Refs are provenance; snapshots are pruned source trees (no weights unless with_lfs_pointers) plus evals/verifiers.

cases.title: Exact geometry prints mojibake instead of pi
cases.prompt: `perci ask "what is the area of a circle with radius 3"` prints `9Ï€` (mojibake) instead of `9π`. Fix the exact-geometry output so π, √ and ² render correctly, with an ASCII fallback when PERCI_ASCII=1.

cases.title: Agent truncate panics on a UTF-8 char boundary
cases.prompt: `truncate` in src/agent.rs byte-slices the string (`&t[..max]`) and panics when the cut falls inside a multi-byte character such as `…` in cargo output. Make it char-safe.

cases.title: Technical 'not answering' questions are hijacked as feedback
cases.prompt: "why is my server not answering requests" is treated as a complaint about Perci (DialogueAct::Feedback) because of over-broad 'not answering' / 'won't answer' patterns in src/voice.rs. Technical questions must not be Feedback; genuine complaints about Perci must stay Feedback.

cases.title: Weight tests pass vacuously without weights
cases.prompt: The Bitwork weight tests in src/cognitive.rs return early when the weight pack is missing, so a checkout without Git LFS shows all green. With PERCI_REQUIRE_WEIGHTS=1 they must fail with a 'weights required ... git lfs pull' message.

cases.title: LFS pointer weights give a cryptic error
cases.prompt: When models/*.pwgt are Git LFS pointer files, `perci ask hi` fails with 'weight file has an unknown magic signature' and exit 1. It must exit 2 and tell the user to run `git lfs pull`.

cases.title: Perci writes memory/ and models/ into the current folder
cases.prompt: Running perci from any folder creates memory/ and models/candidates/ in that folder because paths are CWD-relative. Resolve read-only assets from PERCI_HOME and write state to PERCI_DATA only.

cases.title: Curly apostrophes route differently from straight ones
cases.prompt: Routing rules use ASCII apostrophes, so "how’s it going" and "I’m tracking" (typographic quotes) route differently from "how's" / "I'm". Normalise curly quotes before routing.

cases.title: Internal scaffold hints leak into answers
cases.prompt: Internal context strings such as '[Perci dialogue workspace: act=answer ...]' and '[Perci Bitwork hint ...]' can reach the user's answer. Strip them before anything is shown.

cases.title: Daemon buffers an unbounded request line
cases.prompt: src/daemon.rs reads each request with read_line, buffering an arbitrarily long line before its 256 KiB size check, so a local client can grow the daemon's memory without limit. Bound the read.

cases.title: API key sent over plain http to a non-loopback host
cases.prompt: With PERCI_ENABLE_EXTERNAL_LM=1 and PERCI_MODEL_URL pointing at a non-loopback http host, Perci sends OPENAI_API_KEY in cleartext. Refuse non-loopback endpoints unless explicitly allowed and drop the OPENAI_API_KEY fallback.

cases.title: Recall citations carry a sha256 that matches the note file
cases.prompt: `perci memory recall` must return citations whose sha256 equals the SHA-256 of the cited note file and whose journal offset points at the original line in the append-only memory log; editing a note must be detected by `perci memory verify`.
